Spring Ryogoku card in cherry-blossom season.

How Sakura Genesis connects

  • Topic: NJPW — Sakura Genesis is New Japan's spring Ryogoku card.
  • Event: New Japan Cup — The New Japan Cup winner usually challenges at the spring title show.

What is Sakura Genesis?

Sakura Genesis is New Japan's April Ryogoku Kokugikan event, a spring title show between New Japan Cup fallout and the summer G1.

Key threads lead to NJPW and New Japan Cup.
